subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Land Rover engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the S68 (BMW-sourced) across its Land Rover applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The S68 appears in three Land Rover models — the Defender Octa, Range Rover SV and Range Rover Sport SV — all from 2024-present.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain assembly, valve seals, coolant system components, main bearings and connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, oil filter housing gasket as standard. 48V mild-hybrid components are inspected and measured during the rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Turbocharger problems due to oil starvation are a known characteristic of the S68 V8 BiTurbo — the twin-turbo configuration can develop bearing damage from inadequate lubrication. Oil starvation is a frequent cause, especially after hot shutdown without a cool-down phase. Increased oil consumption is also a known characteristic of this engine. The hot-vee design (similar to BMW's N63) means heat-related component degradation is possible. We don't treat the S68 as having a universal failure mode — diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

typical.title: LAND ROVER S68 (BMW-sourced) REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The S68 uses BMW's hot-vee architecture, with the twin turbochargers positioned inside the V of the engine — a design that adds complexity to accessing certain components. Oil starvation is a known concern for the turbochargers, particularly after hot shutdown without a proper cool-down phase. The 48V mild-hybrid system adds additional ancillary components that we account for during a full strip-down and rebuild. The 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 produces up to 626-635 hp in Land Rover applications, and the rebuild process accounts for the specific BMW M-sourced engine architecture.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain assembly, valve seals, coolant system components, main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, 48V MHEV component inspection
